questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word from the following sentence.**

Empowered

People feel liberated in modern democracies, yet it is believed they are enslaved in their minds.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Enslaved**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Empowered **means having the authority or power to do something. (कुछ करने का अधिकार या शक्ति होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Education and mentorship empowered her to pursue her dreams with confidence.*
 
 
 
• **Enslaved **means held in bondage or servitude, deprived of freedom. (बंधन या दासता में रखा गया, स्वतंत्रता से वंचित)
 
 
• **Example**: *Throughout history, many individuals were tragically enslaved, enduring harsh conditions and loss of freedom.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate antonym of 'empowered' in the given sentence is 'enslaved'.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Liberated: **Freed from constraints or restrictions, experiencing freedom and autonomy. (बाधाओं या प्रतिबंधों से मुक्त होकर स्वतंत्रता और स्वायत्तता का अनुभव करना)
 
• **Minds: **Intellectual and conscious processes in individuals, often referring to thoughts and perceptions. (व्यक्तियों में बौद्धिक और सचेतन प्रक्रियाएँ, अक्सर विचारों और धारणाओं को संदर्भित करती हैं)
 
• **Modern: **Pertaining to the present time or recent times, characterized by contemporary or up-to-date features. (वर्तमान समय या हाल के समय से संबंधित, समसामयिक या अद्यतन विशेषताओं से युक्त)

questions.question:
Select the appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.

We should try to __pacify __the situation and not _____ it further.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Aggravate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pacify"** means to bring or restore to a state of peace or tranquillity; to calm or soothe. (शांत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The mother pacified her crying child by rocking him gently.
 
 
 
• **"Aggravate" **refers to making a problem, injury, or offense worse or more serious; it is the opposite of pacifying. (बिगाड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **Constant interruptions will only aggravate the situation and not help solve the problem.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Pacify'** is **'Aggravate'**.

Therefore, the complete sentence is: *We should try to **pacify**__ the situation and not __**aggravate**__ it further.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mitigate **(कम करना): To make less severe, serious, or painful.

 
 
• **Example:** The government took measures to mitigate the economic impact of the pandemic.
 
 
 
• **Standardise **(मानकीकरण करना ): To make things of the same type all have the same basic features.
 
 
• **Example: **The industry needs to standardise its practices for better efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Illustrate** (उदाहरण देना): To explain or make something clear by using examples, charts, pictures, etc.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher illustrated the point with a diagram on the board.
